    • isPluginEnabled

      default boolean isPluginEnabled(String name)
      Checks if a plugin by a specific name is enabled. If a plugin by the name does not exist, it is reported as disabled. If a plugin by the name does exist, the plugin's appropriate method is used.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the plugin
      Returns:
      whether the plugin is enabled or not

    • getPluginByClass

      <T extends org.bukkit.plugin.java.JavaPlugin> T getPluginByClass(Class<T> clazz)
      Attempts to get a plugin by its class.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the target type
      Parameters:
      clazz - the class of the target plugin
      Returns:
      the plugin (if found) or null
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if clazz is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if clazz does not extend JavaPlugin
      IllegalStateException - if clazz was not provided by a plugin, for example, if called with JavaPlugin.getPlugin(JavaPlugin.class)
      IllegalStateException - if called from the static initializer for given JavaPlugin
      ClassCastException - if plugin that provided the class does not extend the class
